name: Maximilian Weber
bio:
Maximilian's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching DTM races with his father at the Hockenheimring. He pursued a degree in composite engineering, specializing in the application of carbon fiber in high-performance vehicles. Before joining Walkinshaw Andretti United, Maximilian honed his skills at a small German racing outfit, where he was responsible for the repair and modification of bodywork for several GT cars.

At WAU, Maximilian brings a meticulous and process-driven approach to composite repair and fabrication. He believes in continuous learning and constantly researches new techniques and materials to improve the performance and durability of the team's components. While he is relatively new to the team, his dedication to perfection and his ability to adapt quickly have already made him a valuable asset.

What sets Maximilian apart is his deep understanding of the interplay between aerodynamics and structural integrity. He's not just fixing parts; he's ensuring that every repair maintains the car's peak performance. He has a meticulous nature, bordering on obsessive, but is a real asset to the team. He's eager to prove himself at the highest level.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a side part.
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height, with a slender build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against surfaces when concentrating.
Insists on using only German-made tools whenever possible.
